title: Price command center
subtitle: Our prices against competitor prices: price alerts to decide, and the product matches behind them.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the price command center
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the PriceWatch view grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so the screen stays closed. Try again shortly.

tabs.label: Price command center sections
tabs.none: No section of the price command center is open to you yet.

index.intro: Our prices against competitor prices, read from the analytics model: the price index with us at 100, and the lowest-price score.

basisHint.shelf: Shelf: the competitor's regular price against our basic price.
basisHint.paid: Paid: the competitor price a customer pays, offers included, against our effective price.

byCompetitor.title: Price index by competitor
byCompetitor.explain: The price index puts our price at 100: a competitor at 110 is 10% dearer than us; below 100 they are cheaper than us, which is the warning.

byCategory.title: Price index by A-level
byCategory.explain: The same price index for each A-level, one column per competitor.

trend.title: Price index over time
trend.explain: The price index of each competitor by day or by week (Sunday weeks); 100 is our price.

score.title: Lowest-price score
score.explain: The share of our matched items on which no competitor is cheaper than us (a tie counts as lowest). Each item counts once a day, whatever we sold of it.
score.trendExplain: The lowest-price score across all competitors, by day or by week.

index.failed: These figures could not be read.
index.failedHint: The analytics model did not answer. Try again shortly.
index.empty: No price index for this period.
index.notYet: These figures are not in the analytics model on this server yet.

columns.valueAtRiskHint: The gap times our last 30 days' units

alerts.awaitingCostHint: No cost floor is set yet, so no price is recommended.
alerts.count: {{n}} price alerts, ranked by value at risk
alerts.capped: Showing the first {{take}} — narrow the filters to see the rest.
alerts.failed: The price alerts could not be read.
alerts.failedHint: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again shortly.

empty.mine: No price alerts are yours here. Switch to All to see every price alert.
empty.all: No price alerts match these filters.

alerts.changed: This price alert changed since it was read. The list was reloaded — decide again.

dismiss.title: Dismiss price alert
dismiss.wrongMatchHint: Also breaks the product match: the product goes back to matching.

problem.noteTooLong: The note is longer than {{max}} characters.

drilldown.title: Material {{material}}
drilldown.failed: The material's prices could not be read.
drilldown.failedHint: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again shortly.

chart.heading: Price history
chart.aria: Price history of our price and each competitor price
chart.empty: No price history to draw yet: no competitor price was read in the last 30 days, and we are not priced today.

matches.heading: Product matches
matches.empty: This material has no product match yet.

break.confirm: Break this product match? Its live price alert closes and the material goes back to matching.
break.failed: The product match could not be broken.
break.noMatchId: Break needs the product match id, which this server does not send with the comparison yet. A wrong match with a price alert can be broken by dismissing the alert as a wrong match.

grid.staleHint: No competitor price was read within the stale window, so this price may be out of date.
grid.cheapestHint: The cheapest price in this row.

filters.competitorCheaper: A competitor is cheaper than us

grid.failed: The product grid could not be read.
grid.failedHint: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again shortly.
grid.empty: No watched material matches these filters.

matching.noCompetitors: No competitor is set up yet.

queue.open: {{n}} materials still open at {{competitor}}, in our sales order.
queue.failed: The matching queue could not be read.
queue.failedHint: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again shortly.
queue.empty: Nothing is left to match at this competitor.
queue.pageDone: This page of the queue is worked.

matching.noCandidate: Discovery found no candidate for this material. Confirm a product match by URL, or mark it not carried.
matching.mindsiteHint: Offered by Mindsite's product groupings — judge it yourself.

done.notCarried: Marked not carried at this competitor.

discovery.hint: Asks the scraper to search this competitor for the queue's next materials that have no candidate.

problem.notHttps: The URL must be a full https address.
problem.tooLong: The URL is longer than {{max}} characters.

matching.stale: The queue moved since it was read, so it was read again.

feedHealth.empty: No competitor is set up yet.
feedHealth.asOf: As of {{at}}. A listing is stale after {{hours}} hours without a competitor price.

crossCheck.none: The two price sources agree here.

change.label: Change the authoritative price source
change.message: {{to}}’s prices will count for {{competitor}}; {{from}}’s will not. Price alerts, the index and the grid follow from the next run.
change.done: The authoritative price source for {{competitor}} is now {{to}}.
change.failed: The authoritative price source was not changed.
